image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a Rowbrand steam iron resting on a cluttered surface. The iron features a translucent teal/turquoise plastic water tank and body housing, with a white ergonomic handle and rear section. The soleplate is metallic silver with visible steam holes and branding text. A black power cord is partially visible in the background.
